highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 improves Android presentation, stream lifetime handling, and managed image and text processing.
highlights_body: This release also includes the WebGPU implementation in the native library, reducing integration work for consumers using that backend.

bullets.lead: Android texture rendering follows display refresh
bullets.detail: Synchronizes Android texture rendering with the display refresh cycle for more reliable frame presentation.

bullets.lead: Front-buffered streams no longer retain unnecessary data
bullets.detail: Corrects front-buffered stream retention so data can be released when it is no longer needed.

bullets.lead: Image copies and text shaping reduce allocation overhead
bullets.detail: Optimizes managed image pixel copies, feature-string handling, and HarfBuzz UTF-32 encoding buffers to reduce work and transient allocations.

bullets.lead: WebGPU implementation ships in the native library
bullets.detail: Packages emdawnwebgpu's webgpu.cpp into libSkiaSharp.a for consumers using the WebGPU backend.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Included the WebGPU implementation in the native SkiaSharp library
